findings.title: Scroll listener resets the bubble's own scrollTop in the overflow case
findings.evidence: Tooltip.tsx adds window 'scroll' listener with capture=true; reposition() sets bubble.style.maxHeight='none' and reads offsetHeight, which clamps scrollTop to 0, and restores only maxHeight. StagePage.css makes .stage-tooltip__bubble overflow-y:auto. Popover.tsx saves and restores scrollTop for the same reason.
findings.consequence: When text is taller than the room (viewport shorter than ~200px), scrolling inside the bubble snaps it back to the top, so the overflowing text cannot be read. Not reachable at 1280x720 or 1024x768.
findings.minimal_fix: Ignore scroll events whose target is the bubble (or save and restore scrollTop around the measurement, as Popover does).

findings.title: Note: unit tests use mocked geometry and do not exercise the trigger-to-bubble gap
findings.evidence: Tooltip.test.tsx mocks getBoundingClientRect, offsetHeight and offsetWidth. The hover-over-bubble test dispatches mouseOut/mouseOver with relatedTarget. The bubble sits 8px from the trigger.
findings.consequence: The tests check the placement arithmetic and the portal parent, not real clipping or reachability of the bubble across the gap. The old CSS also had a gap, so this is not a regression.
findings.minimal_fix: Cover with the Playwright check; optionally bridge the gap with padding on the wrapper or bubble.
